UnitStatement: The BRIEF_SCHEMA file defines the INIT-TASK dispatch contract for TASK + dbm-postauthor-concordance.
Use dbm-postauthor-concordance after DBM section synthesis and package assembly to build a post-authoring evidence bundle and prepare candidate findings for human readiness judgment.
ScopePath should be the review output directory within the package snapshot.
AllowedWriteTargets must name exactly the seven output files under REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR.
The brief must not grant write access to section output folders, planning artifacts, KTY folders, or source authority files.

ScopePath identifies the review output directory.
TaskSkill must equal dbm-postauthor-concordance.
AllowedWriteTargets lists exactly the seven output files.
RuntimeOverrides.ASSEMBLED_DBM_PATH points to the assembled Rewritten_DBM.md.
RuntimeOverrides.REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR points to the output directory.
RuntimeOverrides.DOMAIN_ROOT points to the DOMAIN root.
RuntimeOverrides.PUBLICATION_SCHEMA_PATH points to the approved schema.

ProposedDisposition is the agent-recommended disposition.
HumanDisposition must be TBD at emission.
After human review, HumanDisposition allowed values are ACCEPT_AS_IS, REVISE, WAIVE_WITH_RATIONALE, DEFER, and NOT_APPLICABLE.
HumanNotes is empty at emission.
DispositionDate is empty at emission.
Required substrate CSV schemas match dbm-draft-review QA_CHECKS.md for Section_Coverage.csv, Draft_Claims.csv, Body_Thinness.csv, and TBD_Inventory.csv.
Evidence_Bundle_Summary.md uses the same ten required H2 headings as dbm-draft-review.
Use FAILED_INPUTS when required runtime overrides are missing.
Required runtime overrides include ASSEMBLED_DBM_PATH, REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR, DOMAIN_ROOT, PUBLICATION_SCHEMA_PATH, SECTION_MAP_PATH, and PUBLICATION_RULES_PATH.
Use FAILED_INPUTS when output paths fall outside the package snapshot directory.
Use FAILED when required outputs cannot be written despite valid inputs.
Use FAILED when a tool exits with code 1 as a fatal error.
Post-authoring review builds a structured evidence bundle using deterministic substrate tools and agent judgment.
The skill prepares candidate findings for human readiness judgment.
This skill replaces the pre-authoring concordance model by extracting and validating concordance after authoring.
The evidence bundle is not a quality gate.
Findings are candidates for human disposition, not automatic blockers.
The skill is reviewer-only.
The skill does not modify section outputs, the knowledge base, publication planning artifacts, or governed pointers.
TASK in generic shell mode with no profile is the suitable shell for this skill.
DBM_PUBLISHER typically dispatches the skill during Gate 6 after section synthesis and package assembly.

EvidenceBundleStatus represents process validity.
EvidenceBundleStatus COMPLETE means all tools ran, all governed inputs were available, and all substrate artifacts were written.
EvidenceBundleStatus PARTIAL means one or more governed inputs were unavailable and the substrate is incomplete.
EvidenceBundleStatus TOOL_ERROR means a tool failed and the substrate is unreliable.
Valid pipeline runs are expected to produce EvidenceBundleStatus COMPLETE.
The skill must handle PARTIAL and TOOL_ERROR states caused by missing, malformed, stale, or unreadable files.
ReviewStatus represents the agent candidate-finding result.
ReviewStatus NO_FINDINGS means agent review produced no candidate findings.
ReviewStatus FINDINGS_FOR_DISPOSITION means agent prepared candidate findings for human disposition.
ReviewStatus REVIEW_INCOMPLETE means agent could not complete review.
FindingType INCORRECT means authored content contradicts governed KTY, SCA, or supersession truth.
FindingType UNSUPPORTED means authored content makes a claim not warranted by the knowledge base.
FindingType MISSING means governed material exists but is absent from authored content.
FindingType FLATTENED means authored content converts TBD, conflict, or assumption into a firm fact.
FindingType OUTDATED means authored content uses superseded source DBM content.
FindingType INCOMPLETE means authored content has the right topic but lacks required engineering detail.
Severity HIGH means significant technical or governance concern.
Severity MEDIUM means notable gap or inconsistency.
Severity LOW means minor quality observation.
Severity ADVISORY means noted for record with no action expected.
The first substrate-building step validates inputs and the write boundary.
The first substrate-building step creates the output directory if it is absent.
If any required input is missing or unreadable, the skill sets EvidenceBundleStatus to PARTIAL and records the gap.
scan_section_coverage.py runs with --section-map and writes Section_Coverage.csv.
extract_claims.py extracts engineering values, parameters, and configuration statements into Draft_Claims.csv.
scan_tbd_markers.py scans assembled DBM for TBD/TBC/ASSUMPTION markers with KB cross-reference into TBD_Inventory.csv.
check_body_thinness.py runs with --section-map and --schema and writes Body_Thinness.csv.
The agent reads authored sections against PRIMARY-role mapped KA artifacts from Section_Map.csv.
For each section, the agent judges materiality, accuracy, and completeness.
When SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH is provided, the agent verifies authored content uses current values.
Every candidate finding must set Origin = AGENT_CHECK.
Every candidate finding must cite governed-truth evidence and trace to substrate where applicable.
The skill writes all outputs to REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR.
Publication_Review_Disposition.csv is written with HumanDisposition = TBD for all rows.
The skill writes seven total output files to REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR.

Section_Coverage.csv provides structural coverage.

Body_Thinness.csv contains section body underdevelopment signals.
TBD_Inventory.csv contains TBD/TBC/ASSUMPTION markers with KB cross-reference.
Candidate_Findings.csv contains agent-prepared findings for human disposition.
Publication_Review_Disposition.csv supports human decision recording.

Publication_Review_Disposition.csv uses FindingID, FindingType, Severity, SectionID, Explanation, EvidenceSource, ProposedDisposition, HumanDisposition, HumanNotes, and DispositionDate columns.
Publication_Review_Disposition.csv FindingID matches Candidate_Findings.csv FindingID.
ProposedDisposition is agent-recommended disposition.
HumanDisposition remains TBD until human rules.
After human ruling, HumanDisposition allowed values are ACCEPT_AS_IS, REVISE, WAIVE_WITH_RATIONALE, DEFER, and NOT_APPLICABLE.
HumanNotes remains empty until human fills it in.
DispositionDate remains empty until human fills it in.
DBM_PUBLISHER does not update acceptance pointers until all HumanDisposition values are recorded with no TBD remaining.
Evidence_Bundle_Summary.md uses the same required H2 headings as dbm-draft-review.
The skill does not modify section outputs, knowledge base, publication artifacts, or governed pointers.
The write boundary is exactly the seven output files under REVIEW_OUTPUT_DIR.
No finding is treated as accepted truth.
Findings are candidates for human disposition.
Every finding row must have Origin = AGENT_CHECK.
The skill does not issue automatic readiness verdicts, PASS/FAIL judgments, or blocking decisions.
Publication_Review_Disposition.csv emits HumanDisposition = TBD and does not pre-fill human decisions.

The preferred tool order runs scan_section_coverage.py with --section-map first.
The preferred tool order runs extract_claims.py second for value, parameter, and term extraction.
The preferred tool order runs scan_tbd_markers.py third for TBD/TBC/ASSUMPTION marker scanning with KB cross-reference.
The preferred tool order runs check_body_thinness.py with --section-map and --schema fourth.
After substrate tools run, the reviewer reads substrate outputs and authored sections alongside mapped KA artifacts for judgment.
The final preferred step emits six evidence bundle outputs plus the disposition artifact.

TASK-enforced allowed tools include python3 tools/review/scan_tbd_markers.py.
TASK-enforced allowed tools include python3 tools/review/check_body_thinness.py.
scan_section_coverage.py compares authored section headings against Publication_Schema.md enriched by Section_Map.csv.
extract_claims.py locates engineering values, parameters, configuration statements, and controlled terms in authored text.
scan_tbd_markers.py locates TBD/TBC/ASSUMPTION markers with KB cross-reference via Section_Map.csv Scoping.md discovery.

Agent reasoning compares governed truth using PRIMARY-role KA artifacts alongside authored sections.
Agent reasoning verifies supersession compliance when Supersession_Map.csv is provided.
Agent reasoning distinguishes material engineering concerns from formatting variations.
Agent reasoning assigns six-type taxonomy and severity.
Agent reasoning cites governed evidence and traces findings to substrate.
Agent reasoning assesses completeness at the level expected for a senior-engineer Design Basis Memorandum.
Agent reasoning writes Publication_Review_Disposition.csv with proposed dispositions and HumanDisposition = TBD.
When SECTIONS_ROOT is available, agent reasoning cross-references section-level QA artifacts from dbm-section-publish.

The skill must not read raw source DBM files except through structured supersession map comparisons.
The skill must not invent engineering facts absent from governed knowledge base.
The skill must not issue automatic readiness verdicts, PASS/FAIL judgments, or blocking decisions.

No other file may be created, modified, or deleted.
